title: Tudor Style Home w/Upstairs Private Ent. Apartment
description:
Tudor style eclectic home in the Heart of East Nashville!  Private entrance to the 2nd floor apartment.  Off street Pkg. for 1 Car.  Great location w/ New Live Music venue at end of Street, Skinny Dennis. 
Award winning cocktail bars within 1/2 mile: The Fox Bar & Cocktail Club, Tiger Bar, Pearl Diver and well known local dive bars: Mickeys Tavern, Gramps and The Cobra.  Many restaurants as well ask for recommendations we got you!   3 miles from Downtown Nashville, 7 miles from Grand Ole Opry.

The space
You will have private access to the Second Floor Apartment.  Apartment includes Living Room, Sitting Room,  Dining Room, 1 Bedroom, 3 sleeping areas total and a Full Bathroom.   Appx. 800 square feet.  Dining area includes Fridge, Microwave, Keurig and utensils needed for a comfortable stay!   Your space is private and unshared.  We live downstairs, with our own entrance.  We are always available for advice or questions.  We have 2 dogs that are also downstairs so at this point other animals are prohibited.

Guest access
Driveway parking for one car.  On street parking available for other cars.

Other things to note
Sleeping areas as follows:  One Queen bed in Bedroom.  One Convertible Sofa with Full Size sleeping options (Living Room).  One Twin Size Convertible Sofa (Sitting Area)
